name: Horseshoe Bay Resort
insider_take: This lakeside Texas gem sits on the pristine shores of Lake LBJ, where Hill Country charm meets luxury resort living just an hour from downtown Austin.
whats_special: Home to the only Robert Trent Jones Sr. designed golf course in Texas, Horseshoe Bay Resort spans 7,000 acres along four miles of protected shoreline. The resort features its own private marina and is famous for hosting PGA Tour events. The property also boasts the largest yacht club on the Highland Lakes chain.
pro_tip: Book a sunset cruise on Lake LBJ during your stay - the resort's location offers some of the most spectacular Hill Country sunsets, and you might spot the resident peacocks roaming the grounds at dusk.
dont_miss: The Apple Rock course's signature 8th hole island green, a thrilling boat ride through Devil's Waterhole on the Colorado River, and dinner at Quail's Roost overlooking the lake. The resort's proximity to Marble Falls also puts you minutes away from some of Texas Hill Country's best wineries.
pros: Championship golf courses with stunning lake views
Multiple dining options and recreational activities
Beautiful lakefront location on Lake LBJ
cons: Resort location about 45 minutes from downtown Austin
Premium pricing for resort amenities and activities
